mapper.select: SELECT no, member_id, password, name, nickname, email, phone, birth_date, gender, postcode, address, detail_address, role, profile_image, last_login_date, agree_terms_yn, agree_privacy_yn, regdate FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT no, member_id, password, name, nickname, email, phone, birth_date, gender, postcode, address, detail_address, role, profile_image, last_login_date, agree_terms_yn, agree_privacy_yn, regdate FROM member WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_id, password, name, nickname, email, phone, birth_date, gender, postcode, address, detail_address, role, agree_terms_yn, agree_privacy_yn ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{postcode}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, 'USER', #{agreeTermsYn}, #{agreePrivacyYn} )
